context: M15 o8. Vault loading dock, W 30th St, after midnight. Ice steaming. A man in a tan sport coat at the door.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Mr. Varelas? I'm here for the monthly. Mayhew sent me.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Tonight? Look around you. I'm wet to the elbow, I'm buying ice by the ton.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Everybody's got a bad night, sir. The envelope doesn't.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: …Yiannis, pay the man. What's your name, collector?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Arce. I work nights at the Corwin. On Thirty-First.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: The Corwin. I… I own the Corwin. On paper.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Then you own two hundred people in a hot building. Good night, Mr. Varelas.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I bought a building. Nobody told me there were people in it.
